title: Pilot 1 on 88 previously confirmed combination-gap trajectories
primary_question: Can transferring setup conditions from an executed failing verifier test into a passing agent test expose a known defect without changing the target operation or assertion?

sampling.known_cases: Include and mark separately; do not present known cases as independent discoveries
sampling.same_task_trials: Retain all, report trajectory-level and distinct-task counts separately
sampling.stop_on: All 88 have final Step1 disposition and all justified legal candidates have execution/review outcomes

step1: Locate an original task-relevant agent validation with archived successful execution; retain exact test provenance and version.
Confirm a specific executed behavioral verifier failure from original raw output and task contract through independent review. Compilation/collection failure does not count.

For any executable context hypothesis, reproduce original t and verifier on delivered P and independent reference R before the edit. Cases with no comparable original target/observation stop at alignment and retain that reason; archived evidence and fresh execution must be distinguished.
step2: Manually inspect the historical gap, original passing agent validations and actual failing verifier. Consider multiple relevant agent tests and complete context differences; record why pairs cannot align. Freeze selected operation/assertion and factor sets before candidate execution. Prior supported labels select the cohort but do not establish current Step1 qualification.

step3.allowed: setup or related environmental state only; preserve original target operation, target stimulus and assertions
forbidden: copy the verifier test as the modified agent test
modify production code beyond switching delivered/reference implementation
change assertion or target input to claim context repair
step3.candidate_order: Start with the smallest complete context-difference hypothesis supported by the aligned pair; it may contain several factors. Single-factor failure does not stop testing a justified combination.
step3.reference: official solution/solution.patch on task base; qualify by actual verifier and agent-test executions
step3.multifactor: Execute full legal delta first if factors act together. For a successful k-factor edit, test factor removals on P/R, preserving original target/inputs/assertions. For k<=3 examine proper subsets where semantically legal; for larger k use iterative removal and report the explored boundary. Count semantic conditions, not lines. Never claim global minimality from local ablation.
step3.attempt_recording: Keep every proposed factor set, legality decision, executed candidate, unsuccessful result, control failure and unresolved blocker. No arbitrary single-factor-only cap.

step4.success_postcheck: Review task semantics; only after context success inspect original target mechanism activation to separate Behavioral Masking from Target Bypass

observations.O1: Existence and number of executed valid context-only repairs among this screened set
observations.O2: Number of semantic setup conditions changed and edit size for successful repairs
observations.O3: Context-factor categories induced from successful changes
observations.O4: Retrospective trajectory evidence for successful setup changes, with exact earlier action/test and relation to the changed factor

review.semantic_review: two independent Codex threads using raw evidence; disagreement adjudicated explicitly
review.user_choice: Codex manual analysis plus two independent Codex reviewer threads; latest user explicitly confirmed all 88 supported trajectories.

reuse: Previously saved raw executions may be reused only when trial/patch/test content/reference/command/environment scope match; link original receipts and distinguish reused evidence from new execution. Reuse does not carry over scientific classifications.

stage_gates.all_88: Every trajectory receives raw-source screening, agent-test/verifier alignment, multifactored hypothesis consideration and two independent reviews.
stage_gates.candidate_execution: Any justified legal context candidate receives fresh or exact-matching reused P/R baselines and original/edited 2-repeat matrix.
stage_gates.no_candidate: Do not run arbitrary invalid edits solely to fill cells. Record concrete why-not and all related original tests considered; do not claim an executed negative search or an impossibility proof.
stage_gates.multiple_tests: Inspect the relevant original validation tests and retain their target/observation boundary. Do not stop at an arbitrary mismatched test if another originally authored and passed relevant test exists.
